metadata.geocoding: Nominatim https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search (raw JSON in docs/research/_raw/nominatim_*.json) and Overpass https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter (docs/research/_raw/overpass_*.json); OpenStreetMap data, ODbL, accessed 2026-09-04/05
metadata.rules: sourced=true only when a cached public source names the place as a waterlogging spot; sourced=false features may be used by the pipeline but must NOT be labelled chronic in the UI. coord_verified=false means the coordinate is a candidate, not a geocode.

counts_after_review.note: unchanged at 13: the one unsupported quote (Kurla/arXiv) was a second source on a hotspot that retains a verified India TV source.

properties.name: Hindmata junction (Hindmata Cinema, Dr B. Ambedkar Marg)

sources.quote: Hindmata is among the low-lying areas in Mumbai and has the unwanted distinction of being among the first areas that witnesses waterlogging whenever it rains heavily.
sources.review_note: Published 10-11 October 2024, NOT the 2019 event. Usable only as a general chronic-flooding statement about Hindmata; must not be cited as 1-2 July 2019 evidence.

sources.quote: BMC has deployed de-watering equipment at Hindmata flyover. It is a low-lying and is prone to water-logging.
We conducted a survey of the six flood hotspots in Mumbai, Borivali, Khar, Hindmata, Dahisar, Malad, and Gandhi market.

properties.notes: Nominatim query 'Hindmata, Dadar East, Mumbai' returned NO RESULT; 'Hindmata Cinema, Mumbai' resolved to this BEST bus stop on the flooding stretch of Dr B. Ambedkar Marg. Spec approximation was 19.012, 72.841.

properties.name: Parel / Bharat Mata Cinema

sources.quote: In Mumbai, waterlogging was reported from low-lying areas of Hindmata junction, Bandra and Parel.
Areas most affected by rains in Mumbai are Sion, Malad, Bandra, Andheri West, Kurla, King's Circle, Lower Parel, Matunga, Thane, Vakola and Palghar.

properties.notes: Nominatim 'Bharatmata Cinema, Parel, Mumbai' returned NO RESULT; the coordinate comes from the Overpass POI sweep (amenity=cinema, 'Bharat Mata Cinema'). The sources name Parel / Lower Parel as an area, not this junction. The point sits ~70 m north of the AOI southern edge.
